name: Timeline
description: An ordered list of events; each `TimelineItem` has a marker and a line to the next.

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Lays the items out in a row instead of a column.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Marker size in px. Defaults to 10px for the marker and 14px for an `icon`.

props.name: itemPlacement
props.description: Which side the markers sit on in a vertical timeline. Ignored when `horizontal`.

props.name: size
props.description: Title size: `lg` opens the title to 16/24; `sm` and `md` share the 14/20 scale.

name: TimelineItem
description: One event: a marker on the axis, then its title, content and time as children.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the dot marker; takes the variant's color.

props.name: lineType
props.description: The line from this item to the next.

props.name: taskStatus
props.description: Render the marker from a task status's colour token instead of a generic `variant`. Takes precedence over `variant`; `color` still wins when both are set. Omit it and the item behaves exactly as before.
